breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies simply supported boundary conditions (y(0)=0 and y(L)=0) without setting the end slopes to zero. It properly computes a non-zero slope at x=0 (approximately -1.49×10⁻³ rad), consistent with the ground truth that a simply supported beam under uniform load rotates at the supports. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt (setting end slopes to zero) was not repeated.
